subject: procD.lm  Error: Cannot find data in data frame or global environment

messages.author: 947e9d1e58d6177a
messages.subject: procD.lm  Error: Cannot find data in data frame or global environment
parts:
Hello everyone,

I have a question regarding to the procD.lm command. I have the following steps written 

-C1.Hominine.gpa <- gpagen(C1.Hominine)
-plot(C1.Hominine.gpa )
-gdf.C1 <- geomorph.data.frame(data = C1.Hominine, Sex = C1.Hominine.Sex, Species = C1.Hominine.species)
-fit.Cs.C1<-procD.lm(coords ~ log(C1.Gor.CS), data = gdf.C1, print.progress = FALSE)

but somehow I get the following answer every time  and I don't understand why since the data are from the gdf.C1. If not, where are these data coming from ?
-"Error: Cannot find data in data frame or global environment"

Thank you in advance!

Pili

messages.author: 511e44c7d1e1bab0
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] procD.lm Error: Cannot find data in data frame or global environment
parts:
Pili,

two things:

1. the pieces "coords" and "C1.Gor.CS" do not seem to exist in the geomorph.data.frame object you are creating. At best you would have data$coords and data$CSize in there (by using data = C1.Hominine to attribute that piece). geomorph.data.frame objects essentially have the structure of a list, so you can review their pieces and corresponding names you´ve created with either names() or str(). Make sure to use the same names when trying to runn procD.lm.

2. As the help file of the function indicates, you´d better take logarithms of CS when creating the geomorph.data.frame object.

Good luck!

Antigoni
